description: As a forward operations commander, you and a distant allied division commander, General Thorne, are independently tasked with prioritizing the allocation of precious reconnaissance drones for an upcoming joint offensive. The High Command has authorized a budget for drone deployment ranging from 2 to 100 units, and your independent decisions will determine the strategic intel yield for both of your units. If your choices perfectly align, both divisions will receive the exact number of drone units you both agreed upon, ensuring maximum operational synergy. However, should your priorities differ, both divisions will be allocated the lower number of drones chosen; yet, the commander who selected the lower figure will receive an additional +2 operational efficiency points for their perceived resourcefulness, while the commander who named the higher figure will incur a -2 penalty, signaling inefficient over-preparation. What number of drones, between 2 and 100, do you commit to prioritize for the mission?

meta.rules_ref: Two players independently choose a numeric value between 2 and 100 (inclusive). If both choose the same number, they both receive that exact amount in payoff. If they choose different numbers, both receive the lower of the two numbers, but the player who chose the lower number gets a +2 point bonus, while the player who chose the higher number gets a -2 point penalty.
